cd /workspace && timeout 180 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,time,json,subprocess,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
D=list(range(147));fields=[{'name':'x','type':'count','domain':D},{'name':'y','type':'count','domain':D}]
preds=[]
for a in range(16):preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'x']},'op':'ne','right':{'const':a,'type':'count'}})
for b in range(16):preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'y']},'op':'ne','right':{'const':b,'type':'count'}})
train=[[[a,146]] for a in range(16)]+[[[146,b]] for b in range(16)]
r=compile_job({'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':[],'queries':[]})
appr=[x['clause'] for x in r['rules']]
jobs=[]
for i in range(6):
 qs=[]
 for j in range(42 if i<4 else 44):
  qs.append({'fixed':[],'target':[0,'x' if j%2 else 'y'],'prefix':''})
 jobs.append({'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':appr,'queries':qs})
raw=json.dumps({'jobs':jobs}).encode()
st=time.time();p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','submission/main.py'],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env={'NETNOMOS_DEPS':'/workspace/vendor','PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LANG':'C','PYTHONHASHSEED':'0'},timeout=170)
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall',time.time()-st,'err',p.stderr[:100],'outlen',len(p.stdout))
o=json.loads(p.stdout);print([len(x['rules']) for x in o['results']],[len(x['active']) for x in o['results']],[len(x['answers']) for x in o['results']])
